problem_evidence.v69_state_partition: typed state resolved 18/18 while matched append-only resolved 6/18
problem_evidence.unscored_development_probe: With an isolated temporary database and fixed full-chat pipeline, session-only answered off-topic, append-only answered stale coffee, and typed-active answered current hojicha. Probe text and values are excluded from V70.

causal_hypothesis: With the same local qwen2.5:7b LeftBrain, deterministic current RightBrain, seed, temperature, psyche, temporary Chroma records, query, condition order, output checks, and token budget, projecting only V69-resolved active profile facts into the existing profile_structured interface will improve profile-dependent final-answer correctness over both session-only and matched append-only projection, while producing zero irrelevant profile intrusions, preserving abstention, causing at most one regression versus append-only, and adding no more than 5 milliseconds median projection cost.
causal_boundary: This tests the downstream answer effect of already-extracted typed profile facts in the current deterministic full-chat pipeline. It does not test open-domain extraction, legacy migration, model-blended RightBrain naturalness, long-term decay, personality learning, VRM actions, or broad human likeness.

conditions.current_session_only_control: After reset, persistent records exist in temporary Chroma but no persistent profile is projected.
conditions.matched_append_only_projection_control: Project every persistent profile row through the same projector without validity resolution.
conditions.typed_active_projection_treatment: Apply the frozen V67 resolver, then project only eligible typed rows through the same projector.

fixed_variables: temporary Chroma backend and record writes
current deterministic RightBrain with model loading disabled
full ingest, cognitive tick, self-monitor, post-check, and temporary episode write
only_changed_component_for_primary_compa: all persistent profile candidates versus V67-resolved active candidates before the shared projector

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Authorize a separate runtime shadow that exposes projected active profile to the planning pipeline while retaining answer_use_authorized=false.
decision_rule.any_gate_fails: Freeze the result and keep persistent profile out of answers.
decision_rule.direct_activation: Forbidden; a fresh shadow and real-chat regression are still required after a pass.

stop_conditions: Stop on dirty tracked tree, artifact or model digest drift, prior-text overlap, production database access, missing temporary isolation, or expected-field leakage.
Do not edit cases, marker groups, forbidden terms, thresholds, projector, seed, or condition order after harness implementation begins.
Do not add holdout values or case IDs to the projector or runtime.
Do not expand the dataset or activate answer use if any treatment gate fails.
